title: Zi Yan in the Herb Warehouse
summary: Xiao Yan still needs the Asparagus Ice Fire Fruit and a Rank Six Water Type Monster Core for the Ground Spirit Pill. Elder Hao lets him take one herb from the Medicinal Ingredients Warehouse in exchange for a Dragon Strength Pill. There he finds the fruit, but a small girl snatches it to eat it raw. She is Zi Yan, a Magical Beast who ate a Shape-Shifting Flower and is stuck in human form. Xiao Yan wins the fruit by promising to refine her herbs into tasty pills, and she tells him she is number one on the Strong Ranking. Elder Hao sends him to the stingy Elder Liu for the Monster Core. Elder Liu wants a Sixth-Tier Fighting Spirit Pill, and in the end takes a Core-Fire Lotus Seed and a Dragon Strength Pill instead.
events: Xiao Yan has the Flame Core Ganoderma and Green Wood Celestial Vine; he still needs two ingredients.
Elder Hao trades one warehouse herb for a Dragon Strength Pill.
Xiao Yan finds the Asparagus Ice Fire Fruit; Zi Yan grabs it.
He promises to refine her herbs into tasty pills; she gives him the fruit.
Zi Yan explains the Shape-Shifting Flower and her lonely life in the mountains.
She tells him she is number one on the Strong Ranking.
Elder Hao points him to Elder Liu, who uses fire-type skills, for the Monster Core.
Elder Liu takes a Core-Fire Lotus Seed and a Dragon Strength Pill for the Rank Six Monster Core.
